The retained evidence establishes neither a Save click nor recipe persistence, stale-only refusal, fresh recovery, or owned-row/observer cleanup. verdict_A_runtime_evidence.guard_sequence: Package and browser guards admitted and finished valid with child exit 0. Native guard admitted at 2026-10-07T06:30:04.581Z with CPU busy 0.0214 and load 0.6 on four logical CPUs. At 06:30:20.827Z CPU busy was 0.98, producing RESOURCE_CPU_PENDING. At 06:30:37.120Z CPU busy remained 0.98 and load rose to 5.27; RESOURCE_WATCH_UNSAFE named RESOURCE_CPU_BUSY and RESOURCE_CPU_HIGH_LOAD_BUSY. The guard emitted a safe-boundary stop, requested SIGTERM of its owned process group, and recorded resourceInvalid=true, exitCode=3 at 06:30:38.735Z.
verdict_A_runtime_evidence.attribution_limit: The first unsafe sample's process census lists owned Chromium 57.2% and helpers 74.4%, 24.5%, and 17.2%, plus owned node 27.7%; provjobd 25% and mds 17.3% also appear. Process percentages are snapshot values and cannot be added to the guard's interval CPU fraction. They show substantial owned browser work during saturation but do not establish a unique root cause, product behavior, or repeatability.

verdict_B_test_and_resource_quality.finding: The guard followed its policy: CPU busy >=0.75 is unsafe, and high normalized load with busy >=0.6 is also unsafe; two consecutive unsafe samples stop. The separate readiness checks and 60-second admission window proved capacity before launch, not capacity during Chromium startup. The failed run remained contained and was correctly excluded from acceptance.
verdict_B_test_and_resource_quality.report_integrity: The initial executor report had one package-journal SHA-256 typo. The executor corrected that field while this review was in progress; a fresh comparison confirms all three reported journal hashes now match the retained files. No journal bytes changed. The mismatch never changed the native invalid verdict.
verdict_B_test_and_resource_quality.limits: No successful same-artifact stale-only runtime result exists in this run. The earlier run 37578280425 had a valid resource decision but failed inside Save before replay, so it cannot fill this gap. No source defect was reproduced from safe contents in this review.

smallest_environment_recovery: For one future attempt, use the existing hosted workflow's sole serialized native slot on a fresh, measured-ready runner; keep the frozen development artifact, same stale-only inputs, existing readiness checks, thresholds, guard, and retained journals. Admit only after its normal full-window check, and stop/report if another CPU episode occurs. Because owned Chromium dominated the observed process census, readiness alone cannot guarantee success; if the next same-run failure repeats, first measure Chromium startup under the existing startup-resource-diagnostic path, then select a demonstrably more capable hosted runner without relaxing policy. Do not call a repeated exit 3 a product failure or dispatch parallel retries.
